title: HLSE Manifest Summary
description: Final NDJSON line of `hlse_core --json package --manifest <file>` — aggregate result of checking every declared dependency for typosquats.

hlse_version.description: HLSE engine version that produced this summary.

manifest.description: Path to the scanned manifest file (JSON-escaped).

ecosystem.description: Ecosystem the manifest was parsed as (pip|npm|cargo|go|gem).

threats.description: Number of dependencies scored ALERT (>= 40) or higher.

max_severity.description: Highest severity across all checked packages (0=SAFE..4=ISOLATE).

gate_hits.description: Number of packages at/above the --fail-on threshold (drives exit code).
